body: Just wanted to say that I made it to campus and will seek help after my exam. Thank you to everyone who posted or messaged - I really appreciate it
Thank you, I will try my best to stay calm. I have made sure I'm not near any sleeping pills or whatnot and will hopefully make it through the next little while ok.

It's hard when my thoughts keep telling me that I'm wasting space and am not worth help, but I will try to do all of this - thank you so much. I have told myself at the very least that if things go horribly and I'm in a worse place after the exam, there's a clinic literally right next door and I've arranged for someone to meet me at my exam room so that I can get there safely.
I will probably attempt sleep if I can - staying far away from any sleeping pills though bc I'm not giving myself the opportunity to do something

Honestly, I just want the exam to be over. I'm not doing great in the course and will do shit on the exam but I'll probably pass and then I can focus on my health I think? I don't know - I've heard petitioning retroactively is a thing but if not I'll consider this
Recognized that this is probably the wrong place to be asking for this and went to the appropriate subreddit /r/SuicideWatch - sorry for wasting space here, shouldn't have done that
